label: the wrench (models/v_crowbar.mdl, models/p_crowbar.mdl, models/w_crowbar.mdl): a pipe wrench: red-painted handle worn to bare iron, a heavy toothed jaw

measured.lineup: ours is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_crowbar.mdl, models/w_shotgun.mdl, models/w_longjump.mdl: the judge does not know which

M1.reason: In sides.png every view shows a plain square bar, about 44 long and 6 to 9 across. From the front and back it is just a small square. The brief asks for a pipe wrench, so the outline should show a heavy toothed jaw at one end and a handle. Nothing sticks out at either end in any of the ten views, so the jaw's outline is missing everywhere.

M2.reason: It measures 43.9 x 8.6 x 5.8 against the brief's length of about 18. The length is off by 144% (sizeOff 1.441), far outside the 15% allowed. That makes it more than twice the size asked for.

M3.reason: There are no parts. The w_ model in sides.png and in-hand.png and the bar in first-person.png are one rectangular box. It has no jaw, no teeth, no adjusting nut and no separate handle. The v_, p_ and w_ models are all the same featureless bar.

M4.reason: The whole object is one flat light grey, seen in all ten views, the first-person view and the in-hand view. The brief asks for a red-painted handle worn to bare iron, but there is no red anywhere. Nothing marks a dark iron jaw either. Only the bare-metal grey is there, and it covers the whole object.

M5.reason: There is no surface detail. The paint wear the brief asks for is missing, along with the teeth on the jaw and any knurling or nut. All that shows is faint mottling on a uniform grey box, in the left and right views and in the first-person close-up.

M6.reason: In lineup.png, D is plainly the odd one out: a grey untextured stick. A is the long jump module, B the shotgun and C the crowbar, all detailed. No player would take D for one of the game's models. In first-person.png, beside the crowbar, it reads as a placeholder box.

M7.reason: It lies flat with its length along the ground, as the game's w_ crowbar does, and does not float. But a box has no head or jaw, so there is no front to judge or orient. Which end is the jaw cannot be checked.

M8.reason: checkErrors is empty, and its 12 triangles are far under twice the median for a weapon of this kind. The views show nothing open, inside out or floating. The measurement allows a 2, and the pictures show nothing that would take it lower.

W1.reason: In first-person.png the bar sits near the middle of the screen, left of where the crowbar sits at the right edge. It points straight up as a featureless stick, so nothing shows how it is held or which way round it is. In attack.png it stays in view through the swing, with a hand fragment showing at frame 3. But its placement and grip do not match the original's, and with no jaw the way round cannot be told.
